meta.title: SRD spell-effect audit (design only)
meta.fieldNotes: srd.* fields are copied from spells.json data (level, school, ritual, castingTime, range, components, duration, concentration) or are exact substrings of data.range / data.description (area, save, attack, damage quotes; "from" names the field). higherLevels.atHigherLevels is data.atHigherLevels verbatim; cantripScaling is the sentence of data.description containing "when you reach 5th level". Everything outside srd is audit design, not SRD.

records.name: Acid Arrow

components.materialDescription: powdered rhubarb leaf and an adder’s stomach

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage (both initial and later) increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 2nd.

records.physicalEffects: No world change. The SRD applies the acid to the target creature only.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature-targeted acid with no object or terrain clause in the SRD. Whether acid corrodes materials is Owner question Q3.

records.name: Acid Splash

higherLevels.cantripScaling: This spell’s damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

records.physicalEffects: No world change. The SRD applies the acid to one or two creatures only.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature-targeted acid with no object clause. Corrosion is Owner question Q3.

records.name: Aid

components.materialDescription: a tiny strip of white cloth

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, a target’s hit points increase by an additional 5 for each slot level above 2nd.

records.physicalEffects: No world change (hit-point maximum of up to three creatures).
records.notes: NONE reason: creature stats only.

records.name: Alarm

components.materialDescription: a tiny bell and a piece of fine silver wire

records.physicalEffects: No matter changes. The ward detects intruders in a door, window or area no larger than a 20-foot cube. The audible alarm is a noise event for AI perception.
records.notes: NONE reason: detection ward. The noise is an AI perception event, not a physical system (see doc §4.3).

records.name: Alter Self
records.physicalEffects: No world change. The body changes stay within the caster's size (SRD: "You also can’t appear as a creature of a different size than you"), so there is no meaningful mass or load change.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature form within its size category. Natural-weapon damage is an SRD creature attack.

records.name: Animal Friendship

components.materialDescription: a morsel of food

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can affect one additional beast t level above 1st.

records.physicalEffects: No world change (a beast is charmed).
records.notes: NONE reason: creature mind only.

records.name: Animal Messenger

components.materialDescription: a morsel of food

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3nd level or higher, the duration of the spell increases by 48 hours for each slot level above 2nd.

records.physicalEffects: No world change. A Tiny beast travels by normal movement to deliver a message.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature behaviour only.

records.name: Animal Shapes
records.physicalEffects: Willing creatures become beasts of up to Large size. The new body's mass bears on floors and bridges (a Large beast can overload a weak floor).
records.notes: Shape change, provisionally classified as a transform (original mass held and restored on reversion) pending Owner question Q1(c). SRD numbers (hit points, forms) unchanged.

records.name: Animate Dead

components.materialDescription: a drop of blood, a piece of flesh, and a pinch of bone dust

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you animate or reassert control over two additional undead creatures for each slot level above 3rd. Each of the creatures must come from a different corpse or pile of bones.

records.physicalEffects: A corpse or pile of bones in the world becomes an undead creature. The remains stop decaying while animated and return to remains when the undead is destroyed.
records.notes: Ledger: remains form becomes creature-held form (a transform). Interacts with SIM.40.10 remains-to-soil decay.

records.name: Animate Objects

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you can animate two additional objects for each slot level above 5th.

records.physicalEffects: Up to ten nonmagical objects become constructs that move and fight, keeping their material and mass. A destroyed object stays in the world as its object or debris.
records.notes: NONE reason: entity-level change only; no heat, force, fluid, cold, earth, light, life or air system is needed. The `animate` primitive is entity-level (doc §3.3). Attacks by the constructs use SRD stat blocks.

records.name: Antilife Shell
records.physicalEffects: No matter changes. The barrier stops only living creatures (not fluids, gas, fire or objects).
records.notes: NONE reason: creature-selective barrier; it does not block matter, so it is not a forceBarrier.

records.name: Antimagic Field

components.materialDescription: a pinch of powdered iron or iron filings

records.physicalEffects: Magical effects are suppressed inside the sphere, including magical fire, conjured walls and barriers (SRD: a wall of fire gets a gap). Mundane consequences already in the world (a fire lit by a fireball, water made by create water) are not magic and continue.
records.notes: NONE reason: meta-effect on other spell primitives. Key schema rule: every primitive output is tagged magical or mundane (doc §3.4).

records.name: Antipathy/Sympathy

components.materialDescription: either a lump of alum soaked in vinegar for the antipathy effect or a drop of honey for the sympathy effect

records.physicalEffects: No world change (creatures are attracted or repelled).
records.notes: NONE reason: creature mind only.

records.name: Arcane Eye

components.materialDescription: a bit of bat fur

records.physicalEffects: No world change. The invisible sensor moves through openings (SRD: a 1-inch gap) and can look down shafts to other layers.
records.notes: NONE reason: sensor only. Cross-layer vision uses GP.07.02 line-of-sight rules.

records.name: Arcane Hand

components.materialDescription: an eggshell and a snakeskin glove

damage.quote: bludgeoning damage equal to 2d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage from the clenched fist option increases by 2d8 and the damage from the grasping hand increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 5th.

records.physicalEffects: A Large hand of force occupies cells (a massless barrier with AC and hit points), pushes creatures, and its fist can strike an object (SRD: "strikes one creature or object"), damaging it. A destroyed object becomes debris.
records.notes: Object damage applies to one object, not to strata, so no floor breach. SRD damage and push distances are unchanged.

records.name: Arcane Lock

components.materialDescription: gold dust worth at least 25 gp, which the spell consumes

records.physicalEffects: No matter changes. The door, window or chest is locked, and the DC to break or pick it rises by 10 (SRD).
records.notes: NONE reason: object lock state. The existing doors system (DEUS_Doors) owns lock and break state.

records.name: Arcane Sword

components.materialDescription: a miniature platinum sword with a grip and pommel of copper and zinc, worth 250 gp

records.physicalEffects: No world change beyond the force attack on its target.
records.notes: NONE reason: the SRD says "a target", read here as a creature. If the reviewer or PM reads it as including objects, add volumeDamage(object) as for Arcane Hand.

records.name: Arcanist’s Magic Aura

components.materialDescription: a small square of silk

records.physicalEffects: No world change (false magical aura).
records.notes: NONE reason: divination-facing illusion only.

records.name: Astral Projection

components.materialDescription: for each creature you affect with this spell, you must provide one jacinth worth at least 1,000 gp and one ornately carved bar of silver worth at least 100 gp, all of which the spell consumes

records.physicalEffects: No world change. The material bodies stay where they are in suspended animation and do not need food or air (SRD).
records.notes: NONE reason: bodies stay in the world. Suspended needs are creature state.

records.name: Augury

components.materialDescription: specially marked sticks, bones, or similar tokens worth at least 25 gp

records.physicalEffects: No world change (an omen).
records.notes: NONE reason: divination.

records.name: Awaken

components.materialDescription: an agate worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes

records.physicalEffects: A Huge or smaller beast or plant gains intelligence. An awakened tree or shrub leaves the flora layer and becomes a mobile creature that keeps its wood mass.
records.notes: Ledger: flora-object form becomes creature form (transform). The SRD material component (a gem) is consumed; component consumption is SRD bookkeeping, not a primitive.

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

records.physicalEffects: No terrain change. The target leaves the world plane for the duration. A creature native to another plane that stays banished for the full minute does not return.

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the duration is concentration, up to 10 minutes. records.name: Black Tentacles

components.materialDescription: a piece of tentacle from a giant octopus or a giant squid

records.physicalEffects: Magical tentacles make a 20-foot square of ground difficult terrain and restrain creatures. They leave no matter when the spell ends.
records.notes: Ground-surface state only (movement cost, restraint). The tentacles are magical, not ledgered matter.

records.name: Blade Barrier

area.quote: wall up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick
ringed wall up to 60 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick

records.physicalEffects: A wall of magical blades gives three-quarters cover (blocks some projectiles) and makes its cells difficult terrain. It does not block fluids or gas and leaves no matter.
records.notes: forceBarrier with partial projectile blocking and creature passage. The SRD states no object damage, so none is added.

records.name: Bless

components.materialDescription: a sprinkling of holy water

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

records.physicalEffects: No world change.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature rolls only.

records.name: Blight

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.

records.physicalEffects: SRD: a nonmagical plant that is not a creature "simply withers and dies". The dead plant stays as dry standing fuel (higher fire risk) and later decays through the vegetation cycle.
records.notes: Ledger: living flora becomes dead organic matter (transform). The SRD's "draining moisture" is not modelled as a water sink (a named assumption).

records.name: Blindness/Deafness

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

records.physicalEffects: No world change.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature condition only.

records.name: Blink
records.physicalEffects: No world change. The caster flickers to the Ethereal Plane and back within 10 feet.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature transport within 10 feet.

records.name: Blur
records.physicalEffects: No world change.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature illusion only.

records.name: Branding Smite

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

records.physicalEffects: The struck target sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius for the duration (SRD), which feeds the light field used for vision.
records.notes: Light emitter attached to a creature.

records.name: Burning Hands

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

records.physicalEffects: SRD: "The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren’t being worn or carried." Added: flammable cells in the cone (grass, wooden floor) ignite and heat dries nearby fuel. The fire system then spreads the fire and may burn through a wooden floor over time.
records.notes: Not a blast, so no volumeDamage. A burned-through wooden floor is a downstream SIM.50.05 + SIM.40.02 outcome, not a direct breach.

records.name: Call Lightning

area.quote: cylinder that is 10 feet tall with a 60-foot radius

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th or higher level, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 3rd.

records.physicalEffects: A storm cloud (a cylinder 10 feet tall with a 60-foot radius) forms 100 feet overhead, spanning about ten layers of open air. Each bolt falls to a point, and added: it ignites flammable cells within 5 feet (the same lightning rule as Lightning Bolt). In existing stormy weather the spell takes control of the storm (SRD).
records.notes: Needs open air 100 feet up (SRD: fails in a room). The bolt's vertical path crosses layers through open sky. The weather tie-in depends on SIM.50.06.

records.name: Calm Emotions
records.physicalEffects: No world change.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature mind only.

records.name: Chain Lightning

components.materialDescription: a bit of fur; a piece of amber, glass, or a crystal rod; and three silver pins

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, one additional bolt leaps from the first target to another target for each slot level above 6th.

records.physicalEffects: SRD: "A target can be a creature or an object". Object targets take the lightning damage. Added: flammable targets ignite (lightning rule).
records.notes: volumeDamage is limited to the targeted objects, not strata, so there is no floor breach.

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

records.notes: NONE reason: creature mind only.

records.name: Chill Touch

higherLevels.cantripScaling: This spell’s damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

records.physicalEffects: No world change (necrotic damage; the target cannot regain hit points).
records.notes: NONE reason: necrotic creature damage. Despite the name it deals no cold damage.

records.name: Circle of Death

components.materialDescription: the powder of a crushed black pearl worth at least 500 gp

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 6th.

records.physicalEffects: No world change. The SRD applies the necrotic energy to creatures in a 60-foot-radius sphere.
records.notes: NONE reason: necrotic damage to creatures only. Whether necrotic areas also kill plants is Owner question Q3.

records.name: Clairvoyance

components.materialDescription: a focus worth at least 100 gp, either a jeweled horn for hearing or a glass eye for seeing

records.physicalEffects: No world change. An invisible sensor up to 1 mile away.
records.notes: NONE reason: sensor only.

records.name: Clone

components.materialDescription: a diamond worth at least 1,000 gp and at least 1 cubic inch of flesh of the creature that is to be cloned, which the spell consumes, and a vessel worth at least 2,000 gp that has a sealable lid and is large enough to hold a Medium creature, such as a huge urn, coffin, mud- filled cyst in the ground, or crystal container filled with salt water

records.physicalEffects: A full-size inert body grows in a sealed vessel over 120 days. The body is new organic mass that did not exist before (only a cubic inch of flesh is supplied).
records.notes: Conjured body mass is Owner question Q1(c). The vessel is a world object; if it is disturbed, the clone is at risk (SRD).

records.name: Cloudkill

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

records.physicalEffects: SRD: a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous fog spreads around corners, drifts 10 feet away from the caster each turn, and "The vapors, being heavier than air, sink to the lowest level of the land, even pouring down openings". Strong wind disperses it.
records.notes: This is the SRD's own cross-layer rule and the reference case for gasVolume with heavy density. It is magical fog, not ledgered matter.

records.name: Color Spray

components.materialDescription: a pinch of powder or sand that is colored red, yellow, and blue

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, roll an additional 2d10 for each slot level above 1st.

records.physicalEffects: A 1-round burst of flashing coloured light in a 15-foot cone. It is a momentary light pulse with no lasting world change.
records.notes: Light is SRD-stated ("flashing, colored light"). Whether 1-round flashes feed the light field is a SIM.60.02 design choice.

records.name: Command

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can affect one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

records.physicalEffects: No world change.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature behaviour only.

records.name: Commune

components.materialDescription: incense and a vial of holy or unholy water

records.physicalEffects: No world change.
records.notes: NONE reason: divination.

records.name: Commune with Nature
records.physicalEffects: No world change. The caster learns facts about terrain, water, plants, minerals, animals and buildings within 3 miles (300 feet underground).
records.notes: NONE reason: read-only query. It needs a queryable world summary (LOD summaries, ADR-003 §6), which is a read dependency, not a physical system.

records.name: Comprehend Languages

components.materialDescription: a pinch of soot and salt

records.physicalEffects: No world change.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature sense only.

records.name: Compulsion
records.physicalEffects: No world change. Compelled creatures avoid obvious hazards such as fire or a pit (SRD), so AI reads the fire and terrain state.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature behaviour only.

records.name: Cone of Cold

components.materialDescription: a small crystal or glass cone

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

records.physicalEffects: SRD: "A blast of cold air erupts from your hands" in a 60-foot cone. Added: heat is drawn out of the cone. Exposed shallow water and wet ground in it freeze to a depth set by the energy, and snow does not melt there. A worked example is in doc §3.7.
records.notes: Freezing is additive (DEC-018: cold freezes liquid into ice). Ledger: water becomes ice (transform). No structural damage.

components.materialDescription: three nut shells

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the radius of the sphere increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 4th.

records.physicalEffects: No world change.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature mind only.

records.name: Conjure Animals

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using certain higher-level spell slots, you choose one of the summoning options above, and more creatures appear: twice as many with a 5th-level slot, three times as many with a 7th-level slot, and four times as many with a 9th-level slot.

records.physicalEffects: No terrain change. Fey spirits in beast form appear, and they disappear at 0 hit points or when the spell ends, leaving no remains (SRD).
records.notes: NONE reason: entity summon. Provisionally classified with no ledger entry (bodies outside Q-MASS) pending Owner question Q1(e).

records.name: Conjure Celestial

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a 9th-level spell slot, you summon a celestial of challenge rating 5 or lower.

records.physicalEffects: No terrain change. A celestial appears, and it disappears at 0 hit points or when the spell ends.
records.notes: NONE reason: entity summon (Owner question Q1(e)).

records.name: Conjure Elemental

components.materialDescription: burning incense for air, soft clay for earth, sulfur and phosphorus for fire, or water and sand for water

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the challenge rating increases by 1 for each slot level above 5th.

records.physicalEffects: No terrain change is stated. The caster must choose an existing 10-foot cube of air, earth, fire or water (SRD: "a fire elemental emerges from a bonfire"), and the elemental appears within 10 feet of it.
records.notes: NONE reason: entity summon. The runtime must query the world for a 10-foot cube of the chosen element. Whether the source matter is consumed is unstated. It is provisionally classified as not consumed, pending Owner question Q1(e).

records.name: Conjure Fey

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the challenge rating increases by 1 for each slot level above 6th.

records.physicalEffects: No terrain change. A fey creature appears and later disappears.
records.notes: NONE reason: entity summon (Owner question Q1(e)).

records.name: Conjure Minor Elementals

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using certain higher-level spell slots, you choose one of the summoning options above, and more creatures appear: twice as many with a 6th-level slot and three times as many with an 8th-level slot.

records.physicalEffects: No terrain change. Elementals appear and later disappear.
records.notes: NONE reason: entity summon (Owner question Q1(e)).

records.name: Conjure Woodland Beings

components.materialDescription: one holly berry per creature summoned

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using certain higher-level spell slots, you choose one of the summoning options above, and more creatures appear: twice as many with a 6th-level slot and three times as many with an 8th-level slot.

records.physicalEffects: No terrain change. Fey creatures appear and later disappear.
records.notes: NONE reason: entity summon (Owner question Q1(e)).

records.name: Contact Other Plane
records.physicalEffects: No world change.
records.notes: NONE reason: divination.

records.name: Contagion
records.physicalEffects: No world change (disease on a creature).
records.notes: NONE reason: creature condition only. It does not spread between creatures in the SRD.

records.name: Contingency

components.materialDescription: a statuette of yourself carved from ivory and decorated with gems worth at least 1,500 gp

records.physicalEffects: No world change. A stored spell triggers on a condition (for example, being engulfed in water) that the runtime must evaluate against world state.
records.notes: NONE reason: meta-spell. The stored spell brings its own primitives.

records.name: Continual Flame

components.materialDescription: ruby dust worth 50 gp, which the spell consumes

records.physicalEffects: A torch-bright flame on an object that "creates no heat and doesn’t use oxygen" and cannot be smothered or quenched (SRD). It is a permanent light source that never ignites anything.
records.notes: Explicitly not HEAT. Reference case for lightEmit with heat 0 and persistence until dispelled.

records.name: Control Water

components.materialDescription: a drop of water and a pinch of dust

area.quote: a cube up to 100 feet on a side

records.physicalEffects: Moves existing water in a cube up to 100 feet on a side: Flood raises standing water up to 20 feet and spills it onto dry land (and down any openings), Part Water opens a trench, Redirect Flow moves water even up walls, and Whirlpool pulls creatures and objects. Waves carry and capsize vehicles, and objects in the vortex take 2d8 bludgeoning (SRD).
records.notes: Where the Flood water comes from is unstated. PM-default reading: a temporary conjured source that is withdrawn when the spell ends. Water that has flowed out of the area by then is Owner question Q1(b). The other modes conserve volume (fluidMove).

records.name: Control Weather

components.materialDescription: burning incense and bits of earth and wood mixed in water

records.physicalEffects: Weather within a 5-mile radius shifts one stage at a time in precipitation (clear to torrential rain, hail or blizzard), temperature (unbearable heat to arctic cold) and wind (calm to storm). It returns gradually to normal when the spell ends (SRD). It affects every open-sky layer in the radius: rain floods, cold freezes, heat dries fuel and wind drives fire.
records.notes: Precipitation is produced by the weather system and logged as its existing named source (rain). The spell changes weather state only. Needs SIM.50.06 to expose stage-based weather state.

records.name: Counterspell

srd.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of you casting a spell

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the interrupted spell has no effect if its level is less than or equal to the level of the spell slot you used.

records.physicalEffects: No world change. The interrupted spell never produces its primitives.
records.notes: NONE reason: meta-spell.

records.name: Create Food and Water
records.physicalEffects: SRD: "You create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of water on the ground or in containers". The food "spoils if uneaten after 24 hours" and then rots as ordinary organic matter. The water is permanent, and poured on the ground it flows like any water.
records.notes: Permanent conjured matter (Owner question Q1(a)). Spoilage is the ordinary food decay path (SIM.40.07).

records.name: Create or Destroy Water

components.materialDescription: a drop of water if creating water or a few grains of sand if destroying it

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you create or destroy 10 additional gallons of water, or the size of the cube increases by 5 feet, for each slot level above 1st.

records.physicalEffects: Create: up to 10 gallons in an open container, or rain over a 30-foot cube "extinguishing exposed flames in the area". Destroy: up to 10 gallons, or fog in a 30-foot cube (SRD). Created water is permanent and flows down openings. A worked example is in doc §3.7.
records.notes: Create mode is a conjured source and Destroy mode a conjured sink (Owner question Q1(a)). The record lists the source by the precedence rule (doc §1.3). Extinguishing is SRD-stated, so the extinguish primitive (HEAT) is listed.

records.name: Create Undead

components.materialDescription: one clay pot filled with grave dirt, one clay pot filled with brackish water, and one 150 gp black onyx stone for each corpse

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a 7th-level spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over four ghouls. When you cast this spell using an 8th-level spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over five ghouls or two ghasts or wights. When you cast this spell using a 9th-level spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over six ghouls, three ghasts or wights, or two mummies.

records.physicalEffects: Up to three humanoid corpses in the world become ghouls, and their remains leave the decay path while animated.

records.name: Cure Wounds

records.notes: Mobile light emitters with no heat.

records.name: Darkness

components.materialDescription: bat fur and a drop of pitch or piece of coal

records.notes: Reference case for the darken primitive and for the light/darkness dispel interplay by spell level.

records.name: Darkvision

components.materialDescription: either a pinch of dried carrot or an agate

records.physicalEffects: No world change.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature sense only.

records.name: Daylight
records.physicalEffects: Bright light in a 60-foot-radius sphere plus dim light for another 60 feet. A 60-foot radius spans up to 12 layers vertically through open shafts, and the light can move with an object. It dispels overlapping darkness spells of 3rd level or lower (SRD).
records.notes: The SRD does not call this sunlight, so no plant-growth effect is added. Rendering cross-layer light is presentation (WG.00.18, Owner-led, DEC-011).

records.name: Death Ward
records.physicalEffects: No world change.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature protection only.

records.name: Delayed Blast Fireball

components.materialDescription: a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur

damage.quote: fire damage equal to the total accumulated damage

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the base damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 7th.

records.physicalEffects: The bead later explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere that "spreads around corners". SRD: "The fire damages objects in the area and ignites flammable objects". records.name: Demiplane

records.notes: NONE reason: no physical system in the world. Ledger: extraplanar-held form (transform), which is effectively a sink if never reopened (Owner question Q1(d)).

records.name: Detect Evil and Good
records.physicalEffects: No world change. The sense passes through barriers but is blocked by "1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt" (SRD), so it reaches adjacent layers through thin floors.
records.notes: NONE reason: sense only. It needs a material-thickness query along the path through strata (read-only).

records.name: Detect Magic
records.physicalEffects: No world change. Same material-thickness blocking as Detect Evil and Good.
records.notes: NONE reason: sense only (read-only strata query).

records.name: Detect Poison and Disease

records.physicalEffects: No world change. Same material-thickness blocking as Detect Evil and Good.
records.notes: NONE reason: sense only (read-only strata query).

records.name: Detect Thoughts

components.materialDescription: a copper piece

records.physicalEffects: No world change. Blocked by "2 feet of rock, 2 inches of any metal other than lead, or a thin sheet of lead" (SRD).
records.notes: NONE reason: sense only (read-only strata query).

records.name: Dimension Door
records.physicalEffects: No terrain change. The caster teleports up to 500 feet in 3D (SRD example: "200 feet straight downward", which is 20 layers). Arriving in an occupied space causes 4d6 force damage and the spell fails.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature transport. Cross-layer destinations need a 3D occupancy query against sparse strata (WG.00.17).

records.name: Disguise Self
records.physicalEffects: No world change.
records.notes: NONE reason: illusion on a creature only.

records.name: Disintegrate

components.materialDescription: a lodestone and a pinch of dust

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 3d6 for each slot level above 6th.

records.physicalEffects: SRD: it "automatically disintegrates a Large or smaller nonmagical object or a creation of magical force", and for a Huge or larger object it "disintegrates a 10-foot- cube portion of it". A creature brought to 0 hit points becomes "a pile of fine gray dust". Added: treating terrain as a Huge object, a 10-foot cube of floor, wall or rock is removed, opening a hole into the layer below.
records.notes: Ledger: matter becomes dust (transform, all mass kept as a dust or sediment form). Treating strata as a "Huge or larger object" is an audit reading (MEDIUM). It ends force creations such as Wall of Force (magicEnd).

records.name: Dispel Evil and Good

components.materialDescription: holy water or powdered silver and iron

records.physicalEffects: No terrain change. It can send an extraplanar creature back to its home plane.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature and planar effect (Owner question Q1(d)).

records.name: Dispel Magic

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you automatically end the effects of a spell on the target if the spell’s level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you used.

records.physicalEffects: Ends spells on a creature, object or magical effect. Ending a spell ends its magical primitives early. For example, a non-permanent Wall of Stone vanishes (its paired sink fires), while mundane consequences such as a fire it lit or permanent created water remain.
records.notes: NONE reason: meta-effect. Its ledger effect is the ended spell's own sink, logged under that spell's cause.

records.name: Divination

components.materialDescription: incense and a sacrificial offering appropriate to your religion, together worth at least 25 gp, which the spell consumes

records.physicalEffects: No world change.
records.notes: NONE reason: divination.

records.name: Divine Favor
records.physicalEffects: No world change (extra radiant weapon damage).
records.notes: NONE reason: creature attack bonus only.

records.name: Divine Word
records.physicalEffects: No terrain change. Extraplanar creatures may be sent back to their home planes.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature conditions and planar return (Owner question Q1(d)).

records.name: Dominate Beast

When you use a 6th-level spell slot, the duration is concentration, up to 1 hour. When you use a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the duration is concentration, up to 8 hours.

records.physicalEffects: No world change.

records.physicalEffects: No world change.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature mind only.

records.name: Druidcraft
records.physicalEffects: SRD: "You instantly light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire", or "instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom". The other options are harmless sensory effects in a 5-foot cube.
records.notes: Small-scale ignite and extinguish on a named fire source (a DEUS_Fire hearth or source object). The bloom is a growth-stage change with negligible mass.

records.name: Earthquake

components.materialDescription: a pinch of dirt, a piece of rock, and a lump of clay

records.physicalEffects: SRD: the ground in a 100-foot-radius circle becomes difficult terrain, and structures on the ground take 50 bludgeoning damage per turn and collapse at 0 hit points, burying creatures in rubble. 1d6 fissures open, each "1d10 × 10 feet deep, 10 feet wide" (1 to 10 layers deep) and running across the area, and "A fissure that opens beneath a structure causes it to automatically collapse". Added: fissures are cut through strata and floors of lower layers, the displaced strata are kept as rubble (mass-conserving), and collapses cascade through SIM.40.02. A worked example is in doc §3.7.
records.notes: The SRD itself specifies structural damage, collapse and burial. Fissure matter conservation is an audit design choice: displaced volume becomes rubble and compaction on the rims and floor. Fissures open "in locations chosen by the GM", which needs a deterministic seeded rule (ADR-003 §10.1). Depends on SIM.50.10 (catastrophic geological events).

records.name: Eldritch Blast
records.physicalEffects: No world change. The force beam targets a creature.
records.notes: NONE reason: the SRD target is "a creature".

records.name: Enhance Ability

components.materialDescription: fur or a feather from a beast

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

records.physicalEffects: No world change. Cat's Grace means no falling damage from 20 feet or less (a creature rule read by the falling model).
records.notes: NONE reason: creature stats only.

records.name: Enlarge/Reduce

components.materialDescription: a pinch of powdered iron

records.physicalEffects: SRD: a creature or object doubles in size and its "weight is multiplied by eight", or halves in size with weight "reduced to one-eighth of normal". The changed weight bears on floors and bridges (an enlarged object can overload a span, SIM.40.01) and reverts when the spell ends.
records.notes: An SRD-stated temporary mass change: a source when enlarged, a sink when reduced, paired at the end (Owner question Q1(c)). Objects use the same bodyTransform primitive (mass scale), so LIFE here covers object mass too. Structural load is a SIM.40.01 dependency, not a FORCE primitive.

records.name: Entangle
records.physicalEffects: SRD: "Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square", making difficult terrain and restraining creatures, and "When the spell ends, the conjured plants wilt away." Added: the vines are organic cover on the ground while they last.
records.notes: The SRD calls them "conjured plants": a temporary conjured source with a paired sink at the end (Owner question Q1(b)). Whether they burn is SRD-silent (Owner question Q4).

records.name: Enthrall

records.notes: NONE reason: creature mind only.

records.physicalEffects: No matter changes. On the Ethereal Plane the caster moves through objects, which includes floors between layers. On return inside a solid object the caster is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes force damage (SRD).

records.notes: Mass-conserving transform (raw material becomes product plus offcuts). SIM.40.01 applies to fabricated spans.

records.name: Faerie Fire
records.physicalEffects: Objects in a 20-foot cube and failing creatures are outlined in light and shed dim light in a 10-foot radius (SRD). It is not fire.

records.notes: NONE reason: temporary hit points.

components.materialDescription: a white feather or the heart of a hen

records.notes: NONE reason: it modifies the falling rule for creatures. It depends on the height-based falling model (WG.00.19, GP.07.02).

records.notes: NONE reason: entity summon (Owner question Q1(e)).

records.notes: NONE reason: entity summon (Owner question Q1(e)).

components.materialDescription: a set of divinatory tools— such as bones, ivory sticks, cards, teeth, or carved runes—worth 100 gp and an object from the location you wish to find

records.physicalEffects: No world change. The caster learns the most direct route, which needs a multi-layer path query over stairs, ramps and shafts (WG.00.20).
records.notes: NONE reason: read-only pathfinding query.

records.notes: NONE reason: sense only.

records.notes: Ledger: remains form becomes creature-held form (transform). The necrotic damage itself has no world effect.

components.materialDescription: a bit of phosphorus or a firefly

records.physicalEffects: Thin, wispy flames wreathe the caster and shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for another 10 feet (SRD). Their only damage is to melee attackers.
records.notes: The SRD does not say the flames ignite surroundings, so no ignite is added. Whether they should is Owner question Q4.

A worked example is in doc §3.7.
records.notes: The Owner-named reference case (DEC-013 §4, DEC-022 §4, SIM.60.04 fixture: fireball floor breach).

records.notes: Needs a per-cast exclusion filter (plants excluded) on ignite and volumeDamage. Fire-type structural damage attenuates by material (SIM.40.01).

records.name: Flame Blade

components.materialDescription: leaf of sumac

records.physicalEffects: A fiery blade sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for another 10 feet (SRD). Added: a flammable object struck by it ignites (the Fire Bolt rule applied to fire damage).
records.notes: Ignition is additive (generalising the SRD ignite clause to fire-damage hits on flammable objects).

records.name: Flame Strike

components.materialDescription: pinch of sulfur

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the fire damage or the radiant damage (your choice) increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 5th.

records.physicalEffects: A 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high column of divine fire (four layers tall) "roars down from the heavens". Added: flammable cells in the column ignite. Indoors, the column is clipped by the first solid ceiling above the target.
records.notes: Not described as an explosion, so no volumeDamage. The radiant half has no world effect. Clipping the column at a roof is an audit reading (MEDIUM).

records.name: Flaming Sphere

components.materialDescription: a bit of tallow, a pinch of brimstone, and a dusting of powdered iron

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

"The sphere ignites flammable objects not being worn or carried, and it sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet." It moves up to 30 feet per turn and can jump 5-foot barriers and 10-foot-wide pits.
records.notes: A mobile ignition and light source. Whether it falls into a shaft when rolled over one is SRD-silent (Owner question Q4).

records.name: Flesh to Stone

components.materialDescription: a pinch of lime, water, and earth

records.physicalEffects: A creature turns to stone. Under the SRD petrified condition (srd:condition:petrified) its weight "increases by a factor of ten". The statue is a heavy stone object that loads floors and can be broken.
records.notes: Cross-family transmutation (organic becomes stone) with a tenfold mass change (Owner question Q1(c)).

records.name: Floating Disk

components.materialDescription: a drop of mercury

records.physicalEffects: A 3-foot plane of force carries up to 500 pounds, follows the caster across uneven terrain and up or down stairs and slopes, but "can’t cross an elevation change of 10 feet or more" (one layer). If overloaded or when the spell ends, its load falls (SRD).
records.notes: A massless load-carrying platform. It crosses layers only by connectors (stairs and slopes), matching DEC-019 and WG.00.20.

records.name: Fly

components.materialDescription: a wing feather from any bird

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd.

records.physicalEffects: No matter changes. A flying creature can cross open-sky layers. SRD: "When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft", which can be a multi-layer fall in the Upper bands.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature movement. It depends on the height-based falling model.

records.name: Fog Cloud

records.physicalEffects: SRD: a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog that "spreads around corners", is heavily obscured, and lasts "until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it". The fog spreads through openings into adjacent layers.

can be up to 10 feet on a side

records.notes: forceBarrier variants: cage (blocks creatures, passes fluids and gas) and box (blocks all matter). Whether a force box bears load is SRD-silent (Owner question Q4).

records.name: Foresight

records.notes: NONE reason: creature rolls only.

records.name: Freezing Sphere

records.name: Gaseous Form

records.name: Gust of Wind

components.materialDescription: a legume seed

records.physicalEffects: SRD: a 60-foot by 10-foot line of strong wind pushes creatures 15 feet. "The gust disperses gas or vapor, and it extinguishes candles, torches, and similar unprotected flames in the area" and has a 50 percent chance to extinguish protected flames. Added: larger fires in the line are fanned downwind (SIM.50.05 wind rule), and loose light objects are pushed.
records.notes: Reference case for windField. Extinguishing and dispersal are SRD-stated. Fanning big fires is additive and follows the fire system's wind model.

records.name: Hallow

records.physicalEffects: A consecrated area of up to 60-foot radius bars some creature types and can bind an extra effect. Of these, Darkness and Daylight change the light field. Everlasting Rest stops interred bodies becoming undead. The rest are creature rules.
records.notes: Only the Darkness and Daylight options are physical. Silence is a sound rule (no physical system proposed).

records.name: Hallucinatory Terrain

records.notes: NONE reason: illusion. Movement is unaffected, so no surfaceState is needed.

records.name: Heat Metal

components.materialDescription: a piece of iron and a flame

records.physicalEffects: SRD: a manufactured metal object is made "to glow red-hot" for the duration. Added: the hot object passes heat to what it touches, so flammable material in contact with it (straw, cloth, a wooden floor) can ignite, and ice or snow it rests on melts.
records.notes: Contact heat transfer from a heatFlux on one object. Contact ignition is additive (Owner question Q3 covers the scope of added fire effects).

records.name: Hellish Rebuke

srd.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take in response to being damaged by a creature within 60 feet of you that you can see

records.physicalEffects: No world change. The flames surround one creature, and worn or carried items are excluded from ignition by the SRD convention.
records.notes: NONE reason: under the audit's fire rule (doc §3.1 R2), fire damage ignites only unattended flammable objects or cells in an area or directly targeted, and this spell targets only a creature.

records.name: Heroes’ Feast

components.materialDescription: a gem-encrusted bowl worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes

records.physicalEffects: SRD: "You bring forth a great feast" that "takes 1 hour to consume and disappears at the end of that time". The food is conjured and then removed.
records.notes: Temporary conjured food with a sink at the end. Whether eaten food becomes body mass or also vanishes is Owner question Q1(b).

records.notes: Light emitters on the caster and on creatures.

records.physicalEffects: No world change.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature damage bonus only.

records.name: Ice Storm

components.materialDescription: a pinch of dust and a few drops of water

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the bludgeoning damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.

records.physicalEffects: SRD: "A hail of rock-hard ice pounds to the ground in a 20- foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder". "Hailstones turn the storm’s area of effect into difficult terrain until the end of your next turn." Added: the hail batters roofs and fragile floors in the cylinder (bludgeoning volumeDamage) and chills the area.
records.notes: Conjured ice. The SRD is silent on whether the hail melts into water or vanishes after the difficult terrain ends (Owner question Q1(b)). A thatch or plank roof is a floor-breach candidate.

records.name: Imprisonment

components.materialDescription: a vellum depiction or a carved statuette in the likeness of the target, and a special component that varies according to the version of the spell you choose, worth at least 500 gp per Hit Die of the target

records.physicalEffects: Burial: the target is "entombed far beneath the earth in a sphere of magical force", which moves it many layers down, possibly below the lowest layer. Chaining: chains rooted in the ground. Hedged Prison: a demiplane. Minimus Containment: the target shrinks to 1 inch inside a gemstone. Slumber: no world effect (SRD).
records.notes: Each form maps to a different primitive. Whether Burial displaces rock and where "far beneath" lies in the 32-layer world are SRD-silent (LOW). Minimus is a mass change and Hedged Prison is extraplanar (Owner question Q1(c) and Q1(d)).

records.name: Incendiary Cloud
records.physicalEffects: SRD: "A swirling cloud of smoke shot through with white- hot embers" fills a 20-foot-radius sphere, "spreads around corners", is heavily obscured, drifts 10 feet per turn, and disperses in wind of 10 mph or more. Added: the embers ignite flammable cells and objects the cloud passes over.
records.notes: Ignition is additive under the audit fire rule (fire damage in an area).

records.notes: Swarm bodies are treated as magical, outside Q-MASS (Owner question Q1(e)). Crop damage by the locusts is SRD-silent and not added.

records.notes: NONE reason: lock state (DEUS_Doors) plus a noise event.

records.physicalEffects: SRD: a creature or object of up to 500 pounds "rises vertically, up to 20 feet" (two layers) and hangs there, moving only by pushing against surfaces, and "floats gently to the ground" when the spell ends. It can lift a target up a shaft or through an opening into a higher layer.
records.notes: A sustained vertical lift through openings. It never breaks floors.

records.name: Light

components.materialDescription: a firefly or phosphorescent moss

records.physicalEffects: SRD: an object "sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet", and covering it blocks the light. The light spreads through openings into nearby layers.
records.notes: A light emitter attached to an object, with no heat.

components.materialDescription: a bit of fur and a rod of amber, crystal, or glass

area.quote: line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide

records.physicalEffects: SRD: a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide. "The lightning ignites flammable objects in the area that aren’t being worn or carried." Added: flammable cell surfaces along the line ignite the same way. The line can be aimed down a shaft or across a ravine.
records.notes: Reference case for the lightning ignite rule. Lightning is not one of the audit's blast types, so no volumeDamage. Whether lightning conducts through water or metal is Owner question Q3.

records.notes: NONE reason: communication (material query along the path).

records.name: Move Earth

components.materialDescription: an iron blade and a small bag containing a mixture of soils—clay, loam, and sand

"This spell can’t manipulate natural stone or stone construction." "If the way you shape the terrain would make a structure unstable, it might collapse." "The moved earth carries any plants along with it."
records.notes: Mass-conserving cut and fill (soil is moved, never created). A 20-foot trench can open into a cave below, and structures are re-checked by the support model (SIM.40.01-.02). It shares strata-mutation machinery with SIM.50.08.

records.name: Passwall

components.materialDescription: a pinch of sesame seeds

area.quote: up to 5 feet wide, 8 feet tall, and 20 feet deep

records.physicalEffects: SRD: a passage "up to 5 feet wide, 8 feet tall, and 20 feet deep" appears in "a wooden, plaster, or stone surface (such as a wall, a ceiling, or a floor)" for 1 hour, and "The passage creates no instability in a structure surrounding it." Through a floor or ceiling it is a temporary connector between layers. Occupants are safely ejected when it closes.
records.notes: A non-destructive, temporary terrainEdit: the matter is suppressed and restored exactly (ledger transform out and back), and the support model is told to ignore it (SRD no-instability clause). It is recorded as breaches-floor because it opens a floor, though nothing is damaged.

records.name: Plant Growth
records.physicalEffects: SRD: in 1 action, "All normal plants in a 100-foot radius ... become thick and overgrown", and a creature there spends 4 feet of movement per foot. Over 8 hours, plants in a half-mile radius "become enriched for 1 year" and "yield twice the normal amount of food when harvested". Overgrowth is dense vegetation (and more fuel for fire).
records.notes: Instant overgrowth and doubled yield add organic mass with no stated source. Provisionally classified as a conjured organic source, pending Owner question Q1(a). The alternative (drawing soil nutrients, a cross-family transform) is part of Q1(c). The half-mile enrichment is a vegetation-model modifier with a 1-year lifetime (SIM.50.04).

records.notes: NONE reason: healing only.

records.name: Prismatic Spray

Each creature is struck by a random ray (fire, acid, lightning, poison, cold, petrification, or transport to another plane). On the indigo ray, a creature that fails three saves "permanently turns to stone" (petrified, weight ×10). The violet ray sends a creature to another plane.
records.notes: The rays strike creatures only, so no ignition or freezing of the area. Petrification is a cross-family transmutation (Owner question Q1(c)), and the violet ray is a planar export (Q1(d)).

records.name: Prismatic Wall

area.quote: up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick
a sphere up to 30 feet in diameter

Layers are destroyed by world effects: 25 cold damage (red), "a strong wind" (orange), 60 force damage (yellow), passwall (green), 25 fire damage (blue), daylight (indigo), dispel magic (violet).
records.notes: A forceBarrier whose layers end on typed damage, wind and spell triggers, so the runtime must deliver windField and damage events to barriers. The 25/60/25 figures are layer-destruction thresholds, not damage dealt, so they are removed from the damage list. SRD: an antimagic field has no effect on it.

records.name: Private Sanctum

records.physicalEffects: A warded cube of up to 100 feet: optionally the barrier "appears dark and foggy, preventing vision (including darkvision) through it". It blocks sound, teleportation and planar travel (SRD).
records.notes: Only the vision-blocking barrier is physical (a darken boundary). The other options are rules wards.

records.notes: NONE reason: creature condition only.

records.notes: NONE reason: creature-targeted cold with no area, so the audit cold rule (areas only) does not apply.

records.name: Remove Curse
records.physicalEffects: No world change.

records.name: Resistance

Impacts load and damage ceilings and floors (GP.07.02 height impact).
records.notes: A falls-crosses-layers case with the direction inverted (up, then down). Whether loose fluids (a pond) also fall upward is SRD-silent (Owner question Q4).

records.name: Revivify

records.physicalEffects: A creature dead within the last minute returns to life with 1 hit point. It "can’t ... restore any missing body parts" (SRD).
records.notes: Ledger: remains form becomes creature form (transform). The unit ID is revived.

records.name: Rope Trick

components.materialDescription: powdered corn extract and a twisted loop of parchment

records.notes: NONE reason: extraplanar space. The drop at the end is a multi-layer fall (WG.00.19, GP.07.02).

records.name: Sacred Flame

Added: the falling water and ice chill the area, and runoff can flow down openings.

records.physicalEffects: SRD: plants within 30 feet gain limited animation. The caster can "turn difficult terrain caused by plant growth (such as thickets and undergrowth) into ordinary terrain" or the reverse for the duration. Plants move branches but cannot uproot.
records.notes: A movement-cost change on vegetated cells (plants hold back or hinder) with no matter change. Plants are neither grown nor killed, so LIFE is not listed.

records.notes: A temporary change of ground surface that reverts at the end. No lasting matter is created.

records.name: Spirit Guardians

components.materialDescription: a holy symbol

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

records.physicalEffects: No world change. Spectral spirits halve hostile creatures' speed and damage them.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature effects only. The speed penalty is on creatures, not terrain.

records.notes: NONE reason: creature-targeted force.

records.name: Stinking Cloud

components.materialDescription: a rotten egg or several skunk cabbage leaves

records.physicalEffects: SRD: a 20-foot-radius sphere of nauseating gas that "spreads around corners" and is heavily obscured. "A moderate wind (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses the cloud after 4 rounds. A strong wind (at least 20 miles per hour) disperses it after 1 round."
records.notes: gasVolume with two SRD wind-dispersal thresholds. It is magical gas, not ledgered.

records.name: Stone Shape

components.materialDescription: soft clay, which must be worked into roughly the desired shape of the stone object

records.physicalEffects: SRD: reshape "a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension", for example "make a small passage through a wall, as long as the wall is less than 5 feet thick" or seal a stone door. A stone floor under 5 feet thick can be pierced, opening a shaft to the layer below.
records.notes: A permanent, mass-conserving reshape (the stone moves, none is created). An opening in a load-bearing floor is re-checked by the support model (SIM.40.01).

records.name: Stoneskin

components.materialDescription: diamond dust worth 100 gp, which the spell consumes

records.physicalEffects: No world change (resistance). The flesh is "as hard as stone" but does not become stone.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature resistance only.

records.name: Storm of Vengeance

area.quote: spreading to a radius of 360 feet

records.physicalEffects: SRD: a storm cloud of 360-foot radius. Round 2: "Acidic rain falls from the cloud. Each creature and object under the cloud takes 1d6 acid damage." Round 3: six lightning bolts at "creatures or objects". Round 4: hail. Rounds 5-10: "Gusts and freezing rain", difficult terrain, heavy obscurement, and winds of 20 to 50 mph that "automatically disperse fog, mists, and similar phenomena ... whether mundane or magical". Added: the rain water floods and flows downhill and down openings, lightning ignites flammables, and the wind fans fires.
records.notes: The broadest weather spell. The rain and hail are conjured water on a large area (Owner question Q1(b)). Acid damage to objects is SRD-stated here (see Owner question Q3 on corrosion).

records.name: Suggestion

components.materialDescription: a snake’s tongue and either a bit of honeycomb or a drop of sweet oil

records.physicalEffects: No world change.
records.notes: NONE reason: creature mind only.

records.name: Sunbeam

records.notes: The only SRD spell light explicitly called sunlight. Whether sunlight spells also drive plant growth is SRD-silent and not added.

records.name: Sunburst

components.materialDescription: fire and a piece of sunstone

records.physicalEffects: SRD: "Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot radius", and "This spell dispels any darkness in its area that was created by a spell."
records.notes: An instant light pulse plus magicEnd on darkness spells in the area.

records.name: Symbol

records.physicalEffects: When triggered, "the glyph glows, filling a 60-foot-radius sphere with dim light for 10 minutes" (SRD). Its effects (death, discord, fear and others) apply to creatures only.
records.notes: Only the glow is physical. Frightened creatures drop held items.

records.name: Telekinesis
records.physicalEffects: SRD: move a Huge or smaller creature, or an object "that weighs up to 1,000 pounds", up to 30 feet "in any direction, including upward", and hold it suspended. Lifting through a shaft moves it between layers. A heavy object dropped from height strikes floors as a falling object (GP.07.02).
records.notes: Sustained directed impulse. Dropping a 1,000-pound load is the case that can overload or damage a floor, through the falling-impact rule rather than a spell blast.

records.name: Telepathic Bond

components.materialDescription: pieces of eggshell from two different kinds of creatures

records.physicalEffects: No world change.
records.notes: NONE reason: communication.

records.name: Teleport

records.notes: NONE reason: transport. The mishap, similar-area and off-target results need a deterministic seeded 3D destination rule.

records.name: Teleportation Circle

records.name: Thaumaturgy

records.name: Thunderwave

records.name: Time Stop

records.notes: NONE reason: action-economy effect. It interacts with the time model (Owner question Q2).

records.name: Tiny Hut

components.materialDescription: a pinch of powder made by crushing a clear gemstone

area.quote: a sphere with a radius of up to 10 feet

records.physicalEffects: SRD: an invisible 1/4-inch wall in any orientation, "horizontal or vertical", "free floating or resting on a solid surface". "Nothing can physically pass through the wall. It is immune to all damage and can’t be dispelled". A horizontal wall can seal a shaft between layers, stopping falling water, gas, fire and creatures, or act as a floor.
records.notes: forceBarrier blocking all matter. Whether it bears load (a floor or bridge) is SRD-silent (Owner question Q4). Disintegrate destroys it (SRD).

records.name: Wall of Ice

components.materialDescription: a small piece of quartz

area.quote: a hemispherical dome or a sphere with a radius of up to 10 feet

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage the wall deals when it appears increases by 2d6, and the damage from passing through the sheet of frigid air increases by 1d6, for each slot level above 6th.

records.physicalEffects: SRD: a 1-foot-thick wall of ice "on a solid surface" that is "an object that can be damaged and thus breached" (AC 12, 30 hit points per 10-foot section, "vulnerable to fire damage"). A destroyed section "leaves behind a sheet of frigid air". Added: the ice chills adjacent cells, and melted or shattered ice becomes water.
records.notes: Conjured ice that lasts only "for the duration". Whether it vanishes or melts into water at the end, and whether melt from fire becomes water, is Owner question Q1(b). An unsupported ice panel falls (SIM.40.02).

records.name: Wall of Stone

components.materialDescription: a small block of granite

area.quote: 10-foot-by-20-foot panels that are only 3 inches thick

records.physicalEffects: SRD: "A nonmagical wall of solid stone springs into existence". It "must ... merge with and be solidly supported by existing stone", can "bridge a chasm or create a ramp", needs supports for a span over 20 feet, and "might cause connected panels to collapse" when a panel is destroyed. "If you maintain your concentration on this spell for its whole duration, the wall becomes permanent and can’t be dispelled. Otherwise, the wall disappears when the spell ends." A worked example is in doc §3.7.
records.notes: The SRD itself gives span and collapse rules (inputs to SIM.40.01-.02). Ledger: a conjured stone source, and a paired sink only if concentration breaks (Owner question Q1(a) and Q1(b); SIM.60.04 fixture: wall of stone vs mass ledger). A ramp or bridge becomes a layer connector (WG.00.20).

records.name: Wall of Thorns

components.materialDescription: a handful of thorns

area.quote: wall up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick

higherLevels.atHigherLevels: At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, both types of damage increase by 1d8 for each slot level above 6th.

records.physicalEffects: SRD: "a wall of tough, pliable, tangled brush bristling with needle-sharp thorns", up to 60 feet by 10 feet by 5 feet (or a 20-foot circle up to 20 feet high). It "blocks line of sight", and moving through it costs 4 feet per foot.
records.notes: Conjured organic matter for the duration (paired sink at the end, Owner question Q1(b)). Whether the brush burns is SRD-silent (Owner question Q4). As dense brush it would be heavy fuel.

records.name: Web

components.materialDescription: a bit of spiderweb

records.physicalEffects: SRD: a 20-foot cube of "thick, sticky webbing", difficult terrain that restrains. Unanchored webs collapse ("anchored between two solid masses ... or layered across a floor, wall, or ceiling"). "The webs are flammable. Any 5-foot cube of webs exposed to fire burns away in 1 round". Webs strung across a shaft form a net between layers.
records.notes: Conjured fuel that the fire system consumes per the SRD's own burn rule. The anchoring rule is a small support check. Ledger: conjured source with a paired sink at the end (Owner question Q1(b)).

records.name: Wind Walk

components.materialDescription: fire and holy water

records.physicalEffects: No matter changes. Creatures in cloud form fly at 300 feet, and at the end "descends 60 feet per round for 1 minute until it lands", falling the rest if it cannot land (SRD).
records.notes: NONE reason: creature movement. The descent is a multi-layer fall rule.

records.name: Wind Wall

components.materialDescription: a tiny fan and a feather of exotic origin

area.quote: wall up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick

records.physicalEffects: SRD: a wall of strong wind up to 50 by 15 by 1 feet. "The strong wind keeps fog, smoke, and other gases at bay", blocks Small flyers, deflects ordinary arrows upward, and "Loose, lightweight materials brought into the wall fly upward."
records.notes: A windField that acts as a gas barrier, plus an upward impulse on light objects. Reference case for wind blocking gasVolume drift.

records.name: Wish
records.physicalEffects: SRD: the basic use duplicates any spell of 8th level or lower, bringing that spell's primitives. Alternatively "You create one object of up to 25,000 gp in value that isn’t a magic item", up to "300 feet in any dimension", which is a permanent conjured object (possibly of metal or stone).
records.notes: LOW: open-ended. The listed systems cover only the object option, and a duplicated spell adds its own. A permanent 25,000 gp metal object is new metal mass (Owner question Q1(a); LIFE-002 forbids ore creation, and Wish would create refined metal).
